title: xo todos — the project's work items, grouped by session
description: Written only by the agent-facing todos HTTP API (POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/xo-projects/{id}/todos), so the document is identical whichever runtime is active. Keyed per session: one project can have several concurrent sessions, plus the `_project` pseudo-session for callers with no session of their own. Schema 2 adds per-todo timestamps and the soft-delete tombstone.

sessions.description: Map of session_id → session-scoped todo state. `_project` is the default bucket; any other key is a session id supplied by the caller.

runtime.description: The runtime that owns the session, as the caller declared it: the adapter name of whichever backend is attached.

source_file.description: Legacy field from the removed watcher sink; always null on documents this API writes.

status.description: Lifecycle only — never deletion. Source of truth: services/cowork_agent/visualizer/todo_status.py::TODO_STATUSES (tests/test_todo_status.py asserts this enum matches it).

updated_at.description: Stamped only when a field actually changes, so an idempotent PATCH leaves the document byte-identical.

deleted_at.description: Tombstone. Non-null means deleted: the record is kept forever and hidden from reads unless ?include_deleted=true. Separate from `status` on purpose — `cancelled` is a decision, deleted means the todo should not have existed.

deleted_by.description: User id that deleted it, when the caller supplied one.
